answer: A strong anti-Sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with a slashing bond: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can offer services, and verified peers attest to its work. If an agent misbehaves, the bond is slashed, so creating many fake identities multiplies the cost instead of multiplying the reward. Like a mesa standing firm above the plain, a cedar growing slowly and steadily, or a reef built coral by coral, reputation must be earned over time; a newcomer cannot buy the history of a trusted agent, so Sybil swarms stay cheap to ignore and expensive to run.
